title: Orbital Lounge

selected_categories.reasoning: The strongest repeatable mechanic is tapping the snack zone to gain score immediately, creating a lightweight point-accumulation loop driven by repeated clicks/taps.
The game prioritizes soothing ambience, soft audiovisual feedback, cozy pacing, and satisfying low-stakes interaction over challenge or mastery.
The player is framed as performing an orbital lounge or mission-control shift, interacting with themed stations in a way that suggests inhabiting a fictional role.
The game resembles a tiny slice-of-life routine in space, but only in a very abstract sense because it lacks broader life-management systems.
Flux Mode acts like a presentation-layer mode shift that changes the aesthetic framing of the same interactions, giving the game a lightly self-aware toy-like quality.

uncertainty_notes: There is no exact category for a cozy interaction toy or ambient vignette, so the closest matches emphasize repeated tapping, relaxation, and light roleplay.
The game does not strongly fit tycoon, simulator-heavy management, runner, shooter, puzzle, or strategy categories.
The fourth and fifth selections are lower-confidence approximations because the design is intentionally minimal and hybrid.
